understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete all levels of the KA59 puzzle game by placing selectable pieces onto goal '+' tiles. Each level had a step budget, and the run ended when steps reached zero without winning the current level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement used a cursor-based system where MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN shifted a selected piece by a fixed grid step (3 units). CLICK attempted to teleport the selected piece to target coordinates. Pieces could be blocked by obstacles or level boundaries, and a CLICK could fail silently if the target was invalid. Some pieces were selectable and moved independently, and goals required all goal tiles to be occupied simultaneously to trigger a WIN.

understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to complete all levels of the KA59 puzzle game by placing selectable pieces onto goal '+' tiles. Each level had a step budget, and the run ended when steps reached zero without winning the current level.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement used a cursor-based system where MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN shifted a selected piece by a fixed grid step (3 units). CLICK attempted to teleport the selected piece to target coordinates. Pieces could be blocked by obstacles or level boundaries, and a CLICK could fail silently if the target was invalid. Some pieces were selectable and moved independently, and goals required all goal tiles to be occupied simultaneously to trigger a WIN.
